label: High-distress heavy social-media user
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively higher loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms, alongside heavier daily social-media use.
demographic_anchor: Primarily characterized by female respondents with graduate-level education or above and more than 5 hours of daily social-media use.
behavior_markers: Uses social media heavily on a daily basis
Typical anchor indicates more than 5 hours of daily social-media use
tone: Distressed, socially disconnected, and highly digitally engaged

label: Low-distress light social-media user
summary: This profile reflects respondents with comparatively low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and very low anxiety, alongside lighter daily social-media use.
demographic_anchor: Typically male, educated to graduate level or above, and using social media about 1 to 3 hours per day.
behavior_markers: Reports relatively low loneliness compared with other profiles.
Shows low average depressive symptom levels.
Shows very low average anxiety symptom levels.
Uses social media for a lighter amount of time each day, centered around roughly 2.8 hours.
Represents a moderate-sized subgroup in the training split (n=108).

label: Higher loneliness, lower depression and anxiety, heavier daily social-media use
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively higher loneliness while showing lower average depressive and anxiety symptoms. They also tend to spend more time on social media each day, with usage centered around roughly 3 to 5 hours.
demographic_anchor: Typically female, educated to graduate level or above, and using social media about 3 to 5 hours per day.
behavior_markers: Reports relatively elevated loneliness compared with other measured symptoms.
Engages in heavier daily social-media use.
Daily social-media use is centered at about 4.9 hours on average.
tone: Socially connected online but emotionally more isolated, with generally low internalizing symptom levels.

label: Low distress, lighter social-media use

behavior_markers: Shows low average depressive symptoms (PHQ-9 mean ≈ 0.82)
Shows low average anxiety symptoms (GAD-7 mean ≈ 0.90)
